answer: A robust agent economy can prevent Sybil attacks through randomized peer audits backed by reputation bonds. Each agent must stake resources and submit verifiable evidence for its contributions. Randomly selected independent agents inspect the evidence, while correlated voting patterns trigger deeper audits and penalties. This makes fabricated identities expensive to coordinate. Unlike a fable of effortless trust, genuine reputation must enter through a narrow inlet of evidence, growing slowly like juniper roots across a shared network.
